entities.summary: Michael Sánchez Bozhulev is a Cuban Ukrainian volleyball player who plays for the Cuban men's national volleyball team. He is a member of the national squad that claimed the bronze medal at the 2007 Pan American Games in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. He also won the silver medal with Al Rayyan in the 2014 World club championship. After the 2007 Pan American Games in Rio de Janeiro he had a major injury, but he recuperated and continued his career.
